tickerText: [TENNIS] Maria Sakkari beat Nao Hibino 7-5, 6-1 on Sept. 24 to reach the Singapore Open quarterfinals against Talia Gibson, Tatiana Prozorova upset Alexandra Eala 4-6, 7-5, 6-3 in a three-hour marathon, and the Laver Cup opens Sept. 25 at London's O2 with Zverev, Alcaraz and Agassi • [SQUASH] Joshna Chinappa and Velavan Senthilkumar beat the Philippines 11-3, 11-5 on Sept. 25 to reach mixed doubles semifinals and assure India bronze, while Anahat Singh and Tanvi Khanna set up an all-Indian women's singles quarterfinal in Nagoya • [BADMINTON] Indonesia rallied from 0-2 down to beat defending champion China 3-2 in the men's team final on Sept. 24, as Mohammad Zaki Ubaidillah won the decider 23-21, 21-13 for Indonesia's first men's team gold since 1998 • [PICKLEBALL] Christopher Haworth won men's singles at the Veolia Arizona Open on Sept. 20 and Anna Leigh Waters swept her draws as the Carvana PPA Tour turns to the Sept. 28-Oct. 4 Rate Las Vegas Open • [TABLE TENNIS] Japan ended China's 32-year men's team reign on Sept. 24 as Sora Matsushima beat Wen Ruibo in the decider for a 3-2 win, China took women's team gold 3-0, and Manush Shah-Diya Chitale assured India mixed doubles bronze on Sept. 25

newsItems.title: Indonesia Ends 28-Year Wait
newsItems.excerpt: Indonesia rallied from 0-2 down to beat defending champion China 3-2 in the Asian Games men's team final on Sept. 24, as Mohammad Zaki Ubaidillah clinched gold 23-21, 21-13 in the decider for the country's first title since 1998.

newsItems.title: Japan Dethrones China
newsItems.excerpt: Tomokazu Harimoto and Japan beat China 3-2 in the Asian Games men's team final on Sept. 24, ending China's 32-year gold streak, while China swept Japan 3-0 in the women's team final in Nagoya.

newsItems.title: Sakkari Into Singapore QF
newsItems.excerpt: Maria Sakkari beat Nao Hibino 7-5, 6-1 on Sept. 24 to reach the Singapore Open quarterfinals, where she faces Australia's Talia Gibson after Tatiana Prozorova's three-set upset of Alexandra Eala.

newsItems.title: PPA Heads to Vegas
newsItems.excerpt: After Christopher Haworth and Anna Leigh Waters won at the Veolia Arizona Open, the Carvana PPA Tour's 1,000-point Rate Las Vegas Open runs Sept. 28-Oct. 4 as the next stop on the 2026-27 season.
